knowledge_point.title: Calculating the Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix With Integer Entries

question.:question/worked-solution:
For a $2\times 2$ matrix, the determinant is given by the formula

$$
|\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}|=ad-bc.
$$

Using the formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}det(R) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 6 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =(3)(2)-(0)(6) \\  & =6-0 \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$
